name: Linear Span Obfuscation
description: Replaces the graph connectivity and measurement concepts with the algebraic linear span of algebraic differences between symbolic states. This frames the task as a basis selection problem in a vector space, which typically suggests matroid or continuous linear algebra approaches. Because the linear span of incidence vectors exactly matches graph connectivity, the problem remains identical, but models relying on recognizing graph properties will fail to map it to a Steiner tree.
